name: Elderfalls
storyline: The Nexus went dark and Azrakel drank its light. You wake on the Isle of Dawn in a world that still remembers the Blackout: the night the Nexus died and its light went out. The Path of the Rift leads from the island to the mainland, and every fallen lord along the way carries his seal. Azrakel, Prince of the Pit, is not finished: he is coming for the last light of the world.
summary: Elderfalls is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG for Windows and Mac, played from a top-down camera. Players start on the Isle of Dawn, choose one of four vocations (Knight, Paladin, Sorcerer, Druid) and sail to a continent of distant cities: Kingsport the human capital, Queensmere the garden city of the druids, Fenmarket the merchant port on the marsh, the elven Elderbough, the dwarven Deepforge and the desert cities of Sands of Sahrim and Kemet of Dusk. Rifts open and close in rotation across each region, leading to linear dungeons that end in a boss and can be repeated with a group. Outside safe zones the world is open to player combat, with a skull system that marks and punishes murderers.
